name: main-functions-test-f228557f7d/main-with-stack-overflow-p.bal
spec_references: ## Module-level declarations: Class definition; Supports `object-field`, `method-defn` and `object-type-inclusion` members
reason: The case recursively invokes self.init() without a base case and marks that invocation @panic, asserting stack-overflow panic behavior during object initialization. Classes, methods and new expressions are supported, but subset10 does not specify stack exhaustion detection or its conversion into a Ballerina panic; support for the panic statement does not cover this runtime-generated failure.
unsupported_constructs: Stack-overflow detection and runtime-generated panic from unbounded recursive initializer invocation
test_design_notes: The @panic marker asserts resource-exhaustion behavior, rather than successful ordinary method invocation.
